messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Compulsory and pre-school education in Schleswig-Holstein during the 2020s, matching this research need: data on students’ learning trajectories in digital physics lessons, including learning difficulties, competence development, learning analytics, and near real-time teacher dashboard feedback to identify productive versus unproductive classroom learning paths
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Schleswig Holstein physics education learning analytics dashboard learning trajectories dataset digital classroom
Germany physics education learning analytics teacher dashboard dataset students learning paths
Schleswig Holstein education open data schools pupils 2023 2024 statistik dataset
action.query: Schleswig Holstein physics education learning analytics dashboard learning trajectories dataset digital classroom

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Learning Progression Analytics – Analysing and Promoting Learning Progressions to Develop Skills (LPA-AFLEK), 2025","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.14414","justification":"EXACT MATCH – This dataset, published in 2025 and archived by GESIS, directly addresses the research need. The LPA-AFLEK project investigates individual student learning trajectories, competence development, and learning difficulties during digital physics lessons. It uses learning analytics to distinguish productive from unproductive learning paths and automatically identify learning difficulties. Teacher dashboards provide near real-time feedback to support instructional interventions. The project involves the Leibniz Institute for Science and Mathematics Education (IPN), the DIPF Leibniz Institute for Research and Information in Education, and Ruhr University Bochum. Its geographical coverage explicitly includes Schleswig-Holstein, with students from Gymnasien and Gemeinschaftsschulen across rural and urban locations. This is the strongest match for the requested research topic. The dataset has a registered DOI and an open metadata record; access conditions for the underlying student-level data should be checked on the landing page."},{"title":"Learning Progression Analytics – Analyse und Förderung von Lernverläufen zur Entwicklung von Kompetenzen (LPA-AFLEK) – B2FIND Dataset Record","url_or_doi":"https://b2find.eudat.eu/dataset/081f2628-a414-5287-a962-df15ba2a4b37","justification":"EXACT MATCH – This B2FIND discovery record describes the same LPA-AFLEK dataset, rather than an independent dataset. It confirms Schleswig-Holstein as the geographical coverage and identifies the research focus as digital physics teaching, individual learning progressions, competence development, automated detection of learning difficulties, and teacher dashboards delivering near real-time feedback. The record identifies GESIS as the publisher and 2025 as the publication year. It is particularly useful for discovering the dataset through European research data infrastructure and examining its metadata."},{"title":"Schleswig-Holstein School Statistics – Schulstatistik, 2020s","url_or_doi":"https://www.schleswig-holstein.de/DE/fachinhalte/S/schulverwaltung/schulstatistik","justification":"CONTEXTUAL MATCH – The official Schleswig-Holstein school statistics portal provides educational statistics and reports covering school years in the 2020s, including 2023/24 and 2024/25. These sources can support analysis of school populations, educational settings, and institutional characteristics relevant to the LPA-AFLEK research environment. They may help contextualize differences between schools and student populations. However, they do not provide individual digital physics learning trajectories, automated learning difficulty detection, or near real-time classroom analytics. Their primary value is as supplementary administrative education data."},{"title":"Directory of General Education Schools in Schleswig-Holstein, 2020/21–2024/25 – Statistik Nord","url_or_doi":"https://www.statistik-nord.de/presse-veroeffentlichungen/verzeichnisse-klassifikationen-systematiken/dokumentenansicht/product/954/allgemeinbildende-schulen-in-schleswig-holstein-236?cHash=5a56d452bafae5ffec13535d2f02a69a","justification":"CONTEXTUAL MATCH – This official statistical resource contains school directories for Schleswig-Holstein covering multiple academic years in the 2020s. It includes information about general education institutions, with machine-readable spreadsheet versions available for selected years. The directories can help identify Gymnasien and Gemeinschaftsschulen, examine the geographical distribution of schools, and establish the institutional context for research on digital physics education. The resource is relevant for school-level sampling and geographical contextualization but does not contain individual student learning trajectories, competence progression measurements, or learning analytics dashboard records."}]}
